basic_info.description: This beautifully upgraded residence at The Infinity stands out for its quiet and serene courtyard outlook, bright open layout, a large den perfect for an office or guest space, and an EXTRA-LARGE private parking with DEDICATED EV charging...a rare combination in the building. Designed by Bernardo Fort-Brescia, this luxury unit features Studio Becker cabinetry, Bosch/Thermador appliances, and stone countertops. The Seller's upgraded custom finishes include newer wide-plank hardwood flooring, custom closet built-ins, and a dedicated charging station in the parking space. The spacious bedroom easily fits a king bed, and has a large walk-in closet.  Enjoy in-unit laundry, central heat/AC, and world-class amenities, including a 5,000 sq.ft. fitness center  w/Yoga Studio & Cross Fit Area, 75-ft indoor lap pool, club lounge, theater, business center, 24-hour concierge, and more.  Prime East Cut location with a 95 Walk Score, moments from Embarcadero, Ferry Building, Oracle Park, and the Financial District. No Mello-Roos tax. A truly special Infinity home!
